divergence: Canonical and relocation-strict objdiff both measure 40.533333%: retail is 60 bytes, candidate is 44. The four named ELF relocation targets, types and zero addends agree, but candidate relocation offsets 0x06/0x08/0x0e/0x14 are four bytes later than retail 0x02/0x04/0x0a/0x10. Integer subobject-address and inline array-selector trials scored 40.2%; an inline setter scored 40.533333%. All trials were reverted; the original independent NonMatching C source is retained.
